title: Thai Herb Lamb Kebabs
description: Delicious lamb kebabs marinated in a Thai-inspired herb mixture, perfect for a quick and flavorful meal. Serve with your favorite Thai sides.
instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine the yogurt, chili flakes, lime juice, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the lamb to the marinade, and mix until the meat is well coated.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Remove the lamb from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
6. Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
7. Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
8. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
9. Transfer the kebabs to a plate, and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
